design_philosophy: Warm, functional minimalism for hospitality operations. Balances dense data requirements with welcoming, organic aesthetics to reduce cognitive load for hotel staff.

layout.card_style: bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden

components.navigation: Sidebar for desktop (w-64 border-r border-border bg-card), Bottom bar or Hamburger for mobile. Use Lucide icons.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Flat header with bg-muted, text-label. Rows have border-b border-border.
components.buttons: Shadcn Button. rounded-lg. Primary uses bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input/Select. border-border bg-background focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20
components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Status specific colors (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800 for 'Paid').

login_background.description: Luxurious lobby background for the login screen.

empty_state_events.description: Elegant outdoor wedding setup to use as a placeholder or empty state for Events.

dashboard_hero.description: Modern hotel lobby reception desk for welcome banners or profile backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans) are imported via Google Fonts in index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors.
Use Lucide-react for all icons, as it is standard with Shadcn.
Build a responsive sidebar layout for the dashboard.
Use Shadcn UI components for Tables, Cards, Inputs, and Dialogs (for reminders/alerts).
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Maintain strict adherence to the organic earthy color palette to keep the app feeling premium, not clinical.
